description: Mux allows one webhook per address per environment, and the spec documents the conflict only as a generic 400. createWebhook with an address already in use returned 400 `{"error":{"type":"bad_request","messages":["A webhook with this address already exists in this environment."]}}` on 2026-11-25. A typed `WebhookAddressInUse` lets callers tell it from other bad requests. updateWebhook can move a webhook onto a taken address, so it gets the same class.

message.includes: webhook with this address already exists
